description: Rows the default-on hydro door (gpuwm/hydro/door.py) tries in priority order for a forecast's parent grid. A new fabric source is a row here, never a new code path. A row is used only when it covers the domain, its data licence is verified, its realization is admitted, and its own tool answers the availability probe. Coverage is a WGS84 bounding box [west, south, east, north] (west > east crosses the dateline) or "global"; the builder decides reach-level coverage. Extra rows can be appended from $GPUWM_HYDRO_FABRIC_PROVIDERS.
